description: A dialog to set the command a host's process is started by over ssh, for a host where baude_headless.py isn't on the PATH or isn't the right one.
opens: host picker's right-click → Host Command… (a host reached over ssh)

parts.name: body
parts.shows: "The command ssh runs on <address>, with connect after it".

parts.name: command field
parts.shows: A text entry about 36 characters wide, pre-filled with the command now set (empty if none), focused. Placeholder: what the host's own setting says, else "baude_headless.py, on its PATH".

actions.does: Saves the command (trimmed; empty means PATH's) for that host, which is then reconnected with it.
